Scouting Summary

Common themes

  • Right Fast, averaging 133.6 kph (up to 140.0).
  • Often takes the new ball (opens in 36% of innings).
  • Typical length is 6-7m (their good length); median 7.7 m.
  • Stock ball is a good length outside off, hitting the stumps (25% of deliveries).
  • Goes round the wicket 13% of the time against right-handers.
  • Across an over he varies his length a lot.

Biggest threats

  • Most dangerous length is Full (4 wkts, 4.0% adjusted strike).
  • Danger pitching line: Down leg.
  • Takes 19% of wickets pitching back of a length down the leg side.
  • Beats the bat 8.3% of tracked balls (false-shot 24.2%).
  • Gets you caught behind more than most — 81% of his wickets (1.2× the typical rate for this type).
  • 0% of catches are behind the wicket (keeper / slips / gully).

Areas to exploit

  • Concedes most runs pitching a good length wide outside off (13% of runs).
  • Short ball: 35% of deliveries, economy 3.9 — 5 wkts from 210 short balls.
  • Away from full, the wicket threat drops off — look to score in the less-productive lengths.
  • Most of his runs leak straight down the ground (41%) — his main scoring release.
  • Cash in when he goes good length wide outside off (economy 3.9, beats the bat only 28%).

Sequencing & Over Construction

Variable with his length (length spread ±2.5 m); with no consistent trend to his length across the over; and holds the same crease position through the over.
Across 21 dismissals, the wicket ball lands about 78 cm fuller than the ball before it — that's the change that brings the wicket.
